g.aria-label: The Position-Wise FFN as a Content-Addressed Key–Value Memory (Geva et al.)
Two-Thirds of Every Dense Block Lives in the FFN (8d² of 12d²)
In GPT-2 Small (d = 768), each block’s FFN holds 4d = 3,072 memory slots (4.72M weights)
acting independently on every token vector xᵢ ∈ ℝᵈ to synthesize factual & syntactic features.
